posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
The pages on the forum are set to cache for a long time, and they don't get reloaded based on your login status. So you may be logged out and go to a page, then log in, then go back to the page and it says you're logged out. Force-reloading the page will work.

This happens to me a lot =)
